title: Implementation Plan Protocol
description: A self-contained implementation plan for implementing one FeaturePoint. It wraps one FeaturePoint snapshot and FunctionalUnit execution nodes; each FunctionalUnit owns directly executable ImplementationUnits, FU-level local verification, and FU-level commit/review boundaries.

status.description: draft is authored but unchecked; reviewed has passed plan-review; approved is ready for implement workflow execution.

feature_point.description: The single FeaturePoint this plan implements. A plan must not implement multiple FeaturePoints.

functional_units.description: FunctionalUnit execution nodes covered by this FeaturePoint plan. Each node owns its executable ImplementationUnits, FU-level verification, and review focus.

notes.description: Optional orchestration notes. Must not introduce scope outside this plan's FP/FU/IU contracts. End-to-end acceptance, deployment, and user validation belong outside implement.

spec_path.description: Workspace/project-relative path to the approved spec.

feature_point_set_ref.description: Optional path, workflow artifact id, or task output id for the confirmed FeaturePointSet.

functional_unit_set_ref.description: Path, workflow artifact id, or task output id for the confirmed FunctionalUnitSet.

architect_run_refs.description: Optional task output ids or artifact refs for per-FunctionalUnit architect runs that produced executable IU nodes.

functional_unit.description: The FunctionalUnit snapshot this execution node implements.

implementation_units.description: Ordered executable ImplementationUnits for this FunctionalUnit. Each unit carries an ImplementationUnit snapshot and exact edit-task input.

verification.description: FunctionalUnit-level local checks to run after this node's ImplementationUnits complete. This is where simple unit tests, focused local checks, lint, or type checks belong.

review_focus.description: Optional FU-level code review focus areas after the node is implemented.

edit.description: Exact edit-task input for this ImplementationUnit.

depends_on.description: ImplementationUnit refs in the same FunctionalUnit node that must complete before this unit starts.

mode.description: implement creates one local commit per completed FunctionalUnit. Deployment, push, and external acceptance are outside this workflow.

repair_rounds.description: Maximum local repair rounds per FunctionalUnit verification or code-review failure.
